views.rationale: BCA revenues increased by $2,446 million for the six months ended June 30 2021 versus 2020, and operating margin improved to –7.8% from –61.6%.
Second‑quarter 2021 sales rose 29% to $12.889 billion and operating profit margin rose to 13.9% from 7.8% a year earlier.
Net income swung to $3.082 billion in Q2 2021 from a loss of $8.270 billion in Q2 2020.
Worldwide sales were $45.6 billion, up 16.9% (operational increase 13.7%) in the first fiscal six months of 2021, indicating strong growth momentum
FPL's net income increased by $79 million for the three months ended June 30, 2021, offsetting broader declines
Income from operations rose to 37.6% of revenue versus 16.8% a year earlier, reflecting higher gross profit and lower operating expenses
Final 2022 Medicare Advantage rates increased industry base rates by approximately 4.1%
Operating income margin rose to 5.3% from 4.4% YoY, indicating improved profitability
